title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
lede: Claude-BugHunter is a skill bundle that turns Claude Code into a structured assistant for authorized bug bounty and external red-team work, loading the right technique by topic.

points: Hunting skills are distilled from disclosed HackerOne reports, with per-class detection patterns, payloads and chain templates for bugs like SSRF, IDOR and XSS.
Covers enterprise perimeter targets such as Microsoft 365 and Entra, Okta, vCenter and SSL VPN appliances.
A validation gate checks scope and accepted impact before a report is filed, and evidence-hygiene skills redact PII.
Internal Active Directory attacks, C2, post-exploitation and evasion are deliberately out of scope.
Installs as a Claude Code plugin, or copies into OpenCode, Codex CLI, Hermes Agent and Antigravity skill folders.

points.text: Three SKILL.md descriptions exceed the documented 1,024-character limit.
A proposal would add a subagent pipeline and a code-driven harness across three stacked PRs.
